panel.title: Details
panel.placeholder: Dataset-specific panel (chart/table) appears here in PHASE 1+.

view.phase0Notice: PHASE 0 — placeholder. Real layers and data ship in later phases.

notFound.title: Dataset not found
notFound.message: The requested dataset does not exist.

common.mockNotice: Mock data (deterministically generated) — real values ship via the data pipeline.

weather.description: Climate normals per Bundesland — annual mean temperature or annual precipitation; climograph shows the monthly cycle.
weather.clickHint: Click a Bundesland on the map or pick from the dropdown.
weather.mockNotice: Schematic climate profiles — the pipeline ships validated DWD climate normals 1991-2020.

population.description: Population development 2010–2030 — choropleth shows growth vs 2010 (red = decline, blue = growth).
population.mockNotice: Simplified trends (Destatis-consistent 2010-2030 rates) — the pipeline uses official population data.

tsWind.description: 8760-h wind generation profile — onshore/offshore toggle; choropleth at selected hour, chart shows the progression.
tsWind.mockNotice: Power-curve + seasonal mock — the pipeline ships ERA5 + real plant positions.

tsPv.description: Synthetic 8760-h PV generation profile — choropleth at the selected hour, chart shows national progression.
tsPv.mockNotice: Synthetic profile (clear-sky + cloud noise) — the pipeline ships ERA5-based profiles.

windOff.description: Offshore wind potential in the German EEZ — mean wind heatmap; existing and planned parks as points.
windOff.mockNotice: Heatmap is mock — the pipeline ships validated ERA5 wind data + BSH park registry.

windOn.description: Onshore wind suitability areas with capacity and mean wind speed; existing WiSTL turbines as overlay.
windOn.mockNotice: Schematic mock polygons — the pipeline ships real WiSTL data + suitability areas.

pv.description: Ground-mounted PV potential sites with capacity (MWp), annual yield (GWh), suitability score.
pv.mockNotice: Schematic mock polygons — the pipeline ships real suitability areas (solar solutions methodology).

phh.description: Household electricity demand — switch between Bundesland choropleth and heatmap (mock 100 m raster).
phh.rasterNotice: Heatmap is mock — the pipeline ships a real 100 m raster (Census 2022).

ghd.description: Commercial / services electricity demand per Bundesland — schematic.

consumptionIndustry.description: Industrial electricity demand per Bundesland by WZ section (schematic — Bundesländer shown as symbols).

mastr.description: Plants from the Marktstammdatenregister — before and after cleaning (duplicates, outliers, geo null-island removed).
mastr.toggleAria: Toggle between raw and cleaned data
mastr.mockNotice: Mock data (deterministically generated) — real MaStR ships via the pipeline.
